gaps: The shared inventory-products source, worker branch/bootstrap wiring, RED/GREEN tests and real process proof are not complete at gate creation.
The report contains persisted operational quantities and unit cost; this gate excludes current-stock derivation, lots, movements, invoices and historical/as-of valuation.
Independent review, global non-promotion retest and final reconciliation remain required.
conditions: Keep the result limited to the authenticated tenant-scoped scheduled read path over inventory_items and the exact eight-field catalog contract.
Do not add migrations, joins, CRUD changes, stock/movement/invoice behavior, valuation, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill or release acceptance.
Keep CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled inventory-products report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only reversible inventory-module and worker implementation plus focused and disposable PostgreSQL/process verification of the existing read-only inventory-products schedule. The source may expose only sku, name, unit, onHandQuantity, reorderLevel, unitCostAmount, createdAt and updatedAt from persisted inventory_items, derive tenant scope from the claimed schedule, apply case-insensitive SKU/name search and strict inclusive UTC createdAt date filters, deterministic name/id order and a 10,000-row bound, and fail closed on missing/foreign/malformed source output. Preserve existing durable schedule execution/export audit and one-shot semantics. Exclude lots, movements, invoices, current-stock derivation, historical/as-of valuation, migrations, CRUD, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing inventory_items schema/RLS or numeric/timestamp semantics, adding joins/fields/filters, changing worker schedule/audit behavior, adding stock/movement/invoice/valuation behavior, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.

next_action: Write and run the intentional inventory-products source, worker and real process RED tests, then implement the smallest bounded tenant-aware persisted source and PostgreSQL proof.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to inventory_items schema, account RLS/FORCE-RLS or persisted quantity/cost/timestamp semantics
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/audit or one-shot failure behavior
Expansion beyond scheduled inventory-products or the existing eight-field contract
